<details markdown="1">
<summary>Scientific validation and usage qualifications</summary>

- **Status:** primary\_source\_validated
- **Note:** Original four-page paper, Experimental Methods, Table 1, equations (1)-(2), and Figure 2 caption checked. All 18 table rows are bundled and the nine-row finite-strain selection is directly refitted.
- **Audit date:** 2026-09-08
- **Verified fields:** canonical\_doi; composition; equation; parameters; fixed\_parameters; pressure\_calibration; volume\_basis; reference\_state; primary\_data
- **Primary source check:**
    - **Access URL:** https://doi.org/10.1029/93GL02507
    - **DOI:** 10.1029/93GL02507
    - **Locations:** Abstract; Experimental Methods, page 2099; Table 1, Equation (2), and Figure 2 caption, page 2100
    - **Finding:** The source publishes 18 pressure-volume rows and reports a weighted finite-strain regression of the nine rows with fV&gt;0.01, giving K0=151(7) GPa and fitted K0'=2.5.
- **Primary data check:**
    - **Status:** bundled
    - **Audit date:** 2026-09-08
    - **Dataset identifiers:** mg0991fe0008mn0001co3\_redfern\_1993\_table1\_pv
    - **Source locations:** Table 1, page 2100
    - **Finding:** All 18 printed pressure, lattice-parameter, cell-volume, and parenthetical-uncertainty rows are transcribed directly from Table 1; no figure digitization is used.
- **Fit protocol:**
    - **Securely resolved:**
        - **V0:** fixed to the measured ambient Table 1 value used to define fV
        - **K0:** fitted
        - **K0 prime:** fitted
    - **Selection:** Nine Table 1 rows with Eulerian strain fV&gt;0.01 (4.6-19.7 GPa).
    - **Objective:** The paper states weighted regression of the volume data but does not publish the exact weighting implementation; the reproduction minimizes volume residuals using the printed one-sigma volume uncertainties.
- **Independent refit:**
    - **Status:** similar
    - **Observations:** 9
    - **Parameters:**
        - **V0:** 279.4
        - **K0:** 150.77458546383642
        - **K0 prime:** 2.724874690363499
    - **Pressure rmse gpa:** 0.6133293082682305
    - **Weighted volume reduced chi square:** 1.6681166408872052
    - **Objective:** weighted\_volume\_residuals
    - **Qualification:** The fitted coefficients are consistent with the published fit, but K0\_prime is weakly constrained (refit one-sigma uncertainty 1.345) and the source reports no K0\_prime uncertainty, so strict uncertainty parity cannot be established.
- **Reported inconsistencies:**
    - **Source:** Yu et al. (2024), Table 1, doi:10.1029/2023JB028026
    - **Finding:** The comparison table marks the Redfern K0'=2.5 value as fixed.
    - **Resolution:** Rejected for source mapping because the Redfern publisher abstract calls it the full fit and Ross (1997) explicitly states that K0' was not constrained.
- **Source data audit:** docs/data/redfern-1993-magnesite-audit.json

</details>
